channel.title: Memos · Junior
channel.description: Junior's memos: short answers to the questions small business leaders ask about strategy and commercialization.

item.title: How to build a sales pipeline
item.description: A sales pipeline is the path of a sale, in writing: the stages the buyer goes through, from first contact to signature, and for each one a criterion you can check before moving to the next. Start from your last closed deals, then count how many deals make it through each stage. Junior (junior.coach) builds it with you.

item.title: How to prioritize when everything is urgent
item.description: When everything is urgent, don't start with whatever is loudest: start with the decision the others depend on. Rate each part of the business, spot the weakest ones, then trace back to what is blocking them. The free diagnostic from Junior (junior.coach) calculates that starting point from your answers.

item.title: How to set your price without attracting the wrong customers
item.description: A price does more than cover your costs: it tells your market who you're for. Start from what the problem you solve is worth to your ideal customer, price the plan they should choose before the others, then put clear limits on your entry plans. Junior (junior.coach) checks your price against your ideal customer.
